svg.title: AWS and DevOps portfolio: from service card to engagement
svg.desc: A buyer opens the portfolio index, whose ten service cards are generated from data/catalog.yaml, and picks a service. The card names the client problem, the repository, the strongest artifact, the verification scope and the Upwork offer; the repository holds the evidence and its own offline make verify. The index make verify, run in CI on push, pull request and a weekly schedule against clones of every listed repository, checks cards, required files, README order and artifact paths: 78 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The buyer then engages the service on Upwork.
svg.text: AWS AND DEVOPS PORTFOLIO · SERVICE INDEX
